summary.text: Son of Nestor of Gerenia — one of the Pylians who came forth with his brothers when Nestor led the dawn sacrifice to Athena for Telemachus' sake; Apollodorus names a son Stratichus in the same stemma.

story.text: Homer names Stratius among Nestor's sons who gathered about the horseman of Gerenia when he took the sceptre in his hands and bade his dear children fulfil his desire — to propitiate Athena before Telemachus journeyed on toward Sparta.
